item.title: Daily Weather
item.description: Hi there! Here is your weather report for Tuesday, September 22. Tuesday already. Well done for a good start! Shanghai is going to be a little bit rainy today. The high will be 30 degrees, and the low will be 22 degrees. Baking hot today, so take it slowly. The chance of rain is 18 percent. The sun goes down at 5:51 this evening, about 2 minutes earlier than yesterday. Can you feel the days getting shorter? Stay cool, drink plenty of water, and find some shade! As for tomorrow, expect it to be damp with light drizzle, with a high of 29 degrees. This week we are thinking about harvest. Anything new today? That's your weather. Have a wonderful day!
